inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Space: The operation was using the requested space prior to approval from licensing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))

occurrences.finding: Report Change in Director: The permit holder or designee did not notify Licensing of the change of director.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Change in Director (26 TAC §746.303(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have available for review a current fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: The operation did not have a monthly maintenance checklist available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Two children enrolled in  care did not have the required physician/emergency-care facility address.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: A child enrolled in care for over a year did not have a required health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Education Outside of U.S.: A caregiver with a foreign degree was not translated into English.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §746.1111)

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A child's food allergy from did not have a parent signature.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Storage for Individual Belongings: The classroom did not have a space set up for each child's personal belongings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage for Individual Belongings (26 TAC §746.4505)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Exposed screws were seen sticking out of the playhouse and an exposed pipe was within reach of children.    This was corrected when the operation used bins to cover the pipe and removed the exposed screws from the playhouse.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: The stationary equipment with the slide measures under the 6 feet use zone requirement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Waiver/Variance - Comply w/ each condition while in effect: CCR observed that the operation did not meet the conditions for a waiver. CCR observed a child climbing on the playground equipment mound/stairs while another child was on the slide without a caregiver supervising the slide area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Waiver/Variance - Comply w/ each condition while in effect (26 TAC §745.8311(b))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: The stationary equipment with the slide measures under the 6 feet use zone requirement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment: Training documentation reviewed did not include the certificate or letter containing all of the training documentation requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training -Required 1 hour in prevention, recognition and reporting of child maltreatment: The operation was not able to provide the certificate or letter of completion including all of the requirements such as the trainer's qualifications.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training -Required 1 hour in prevention, recognition and reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1311(c))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: A caregiver was heard yelling at a child.    Note: the owner was prompted to address the caregiver and check on the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Training Requirements - Trainer's Qualifications: The certificates do not state how the trainer qualifies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Trainer's Qualifications (26 TAC §746.1329(b)(5))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: The operation was not able to provide the certificate or letter of completion including all of the requirements such as the trainer's qualifications.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Waiver/Variance - Comply w/ each condition while in effect (26 TAC §745.8311(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment: Six caregivers are missing child mistreatment training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1309(c))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Waiver/Variance - Comply w/ each condition while in effect (26 TAC §745.8311(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: CCR observed an infant under 12 months old sleeping in a crib with a speaker tied to a string hanging on the wall of the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Six caregiver is missing food allergic training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: The operation has two stationary with slides on a surface that lacks six feet around the perimeter in all directions.    Note: The operation added additional unitary surfacing, but the two stationary with slides are not meeting six feet on the unitary surfacing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training -Required 1 hour in prevention, recognition and reporting of child maltreatment: The director is missing child mistreatment training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training -Required 1 hour in prevention, recognition and reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1311(c))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: The operation has two stationary with slides on a surface that lack a six-feet rom the perimeter in all directions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2024 data from January 17, 2025, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2024 by January 15, 2025, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment: The use zone for stationary equipment is less than 6 feet from the poles supporting the sunshade, and there are two staircases located beside the exit slide.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §746.4803)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions: The operation cares for children younger than five years of age, and on the playground, there is a dome climbing equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.4601(2))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Under the sink in the infant's room, which the operation wants to expand, there is exposed concrete that is chipped and accessible to children, along with a baseboard peeling off the wall.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach: CCR observed a diaper cream ointment with the cap closed in the child's mouth during a diaper change.    Correction: The caregiver took the diaper cream ointment out of the infant's mouth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.3501(6))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Hand-washing Sink in Diaper Changing Area: The infant room that the operation wants to add to the space does not have a working hand-washing sink.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Hand-washing Sink in Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3503(d))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides: The use zone to enter the slides and the exit of the slide is not six feet from the perimeter. Also, the operation has a climbing tower that is not six feet away from the perimeter.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides (26 TAC §746.4805(a))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: During the walkthrough, I observed several cleaning products in an unlocked sink cabinet that is accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation: The most recent inspection form was not posted, the one posted was dated 7/17/2024. The last inspection was conducted on 7/31/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation (26 TAC §746.401(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: An employee was present with a pending background check. The employee inside the operation performing job duties.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: It was observed in the Orchid restroom tiles were missing in the ceiling.      Corrected:  When the operation had someone come replace the ceiling tiles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Employee in the foyer area with they piano out had a pending background check.     Corrected:  When the person left for the day.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: Caregiver stated they had 15 children when I counted they had 16 children in care. In a different classroom a caregiver stated they had 12 children when I counted they were 13 children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: An infant sitting in a high chair was not strap in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: They are two contract employees, the security guard and kitchen employee with out the required CBCU background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: During the walkthrough I observed a caregiver supervising 12 children between 18-24 months without a cleared eligible background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Pre-service Training for Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months: Three caregivers working with children 24 months and younger are missing baby shaken syndrome training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pre-service Training for Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months (26 TAC §746.1305(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two children did not have a health statement on file or any document stating they would bring one in within 12 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: HRC42.041(a) - Illegal Operation - Not Licensed: It was determine the operation subject to regulation was operating without a permit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: HRC42.041(a) - Illegal Operation - Not Licensed (26 TAC §HRC42.041(a) - Illegal Operation - Not L)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have a fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation did not have an sanitation inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Thermometer, preferably non-glass (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(7))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The operation is missing how they would evacuate children younger then 24 months out of the operation doing an emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.501(a)(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Documentation for Unitary Surfacing Materials: The operation did not have documentation on their  unitary surfacing that is installed on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Documentation for Unitary Surfacing Materials (26 TAC §746.4913)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies Procedures for Parent Review Licensing Reports & How to Access Rules: The operation did not have in their operational policies on how parents can find the most recent inspection form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies Procedures for Parent Review Licensing Reports & How to Access Rules (26 TAC §746.501(a)(22))
